events.title: Gentle Yoga for Seniors
events.location: SilverBridge Community Hall, 200 Collins St, Melbourne VIC 3000
events.description: A gentle yoga session designed specifically for seniors. Improve flexibility, balance, and relaxation with our experienced instructor. Chairs provided for seated variations. No prior yoga experience needed.

events.title: Digital Skills Workshop — Using Your Smartphone
events.location: Melbourne City Library, 253 Flinders Lane, Melbourne VIC 3000
events.description: Learn how to use your smartphone with confidence. Topics include making video calls, sending photos, installing apps, and staying safe online. Bring your own device or use one of ours.

events.title: Memory Care Support Group
events.location: SilverBridge Health Centre, Level 5, 200 Collins St, Melbourne VIC 3000
events.description: A supportive group for individuals experiencing memory changes and their caregivers. Share experiences, learn coping strategies, and connect with others on a similar journey. Facilitated by a qualified counsellor.

events.title: Healthy Cooking Demonstration
events.location: SilverBridge Community Kitchen, 200 Collins St, Melbourne VIC 3000
events.description: Watch and learn as our nutritionist prepares easy, budget-friendly meals that are packed with nutrients. Free recipe cards to take home. Tasting session included!

events.title: Walking Group — Royal Botanic Gardens
events.location: Royal Botanic Gardens, Birdwood Ave, Melbourne VIC 3004
events.description: Join our weekly walking group for a gentle stroll through the beautiful Botanic Gardens. Flat paths suitable for walkers and wheelchairs. Coffee and chat afterwards at the Gardens Café.

events.title: Home Safety Assessment Workshop
events.location: SilverBridge Health Centre, Level 5, 200 Collins St, Melbourne VIC 3000
events.description: Learn how to make your home safer and reduce fall risks. Our occupational therapist will demonstrate grab bar installation, trip hazard removal, and simple home modifications. Book a free in-home assessment after the workshop.
